integrity: The motivating 2023 paper already proves the invariant lines, Darboux integrals, and global phase portraits. These are credited. Finite numerical checks do not replace analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the real cubic Darboux family and prescribed positive height. The critical crossover is uniform only for delta in compact intervals. Does not prove generic perturbation robustness or publication priority.
title: A logarithmic-to-Hölder separatrix escape transition in a cubic Darboux flow
